name: Default
shortDescription: Headless Chromium service with a token-protected WebSocket endpoint for Puppeteer and Playwright, REST APIs for PDFs, screenshots and scraping, and a built-in debugger.

alerts.message: Every request needs the generated TOKEN from the environment settings, as a ?token= query parameter or an Authorization: Bearer header. Connect Puppeteer with browserWSEndpoint "wss://<your-domain>?token=<token>" and open the API docs at https://<your-domain>/docs.
